subject: paging = FALSE of renderDataTable under shiny 0.11 and 0.10.1

messages.author: 7c95eca58f093ad2
messages.subject: paging = FALSE of renderDataTable under shiny 0.11 and 0.10.1
parts:
Hi,

I used renderDataTable function for a table and I don't want the pagination, so I set the option paging = FALSE
EX. output$testTable <- renderDataTable(iris, options = list(paging = FALSE))

It worked before and today I noticed that it didn't work, and I tried other options like pageLength, it also didn't work.
I developed in gquest and the shiny version is 0.10.1

But when I tried in R-studio with the shiny version 0.11, it works.

I'm wondering is it due to the version of shiny or where I worked or other reasons?

It's a really important option in our application, so we want to know the reason and try to avoid such situations to keep the functionality of this option be stable.

Thanks very much for the help in advance.

Jie

messages.author: 2955fcac6ef9e99d
messages.subject: Re: paging = FALSE of renderDataTable under shiny 0.11 and 0.10.1
parts:
Hi Jie,

Shiny uses the DataTables javascript library.

Shiny version 0.10.1 used DataTables version 1.9.4. With the release of shiny 0.10.2, shiny was upgraded to DataTables 1.10. The names of the table options were changed from DataTables 1.9.x to 1.10.x. Details of the changes can be found here:

http://datatables.net/upgrade/1.10-convert

In your case, the following should work in shiny 0.10.1:

output$testTable <- renderDataTable(iris, options = list(bPaginate = FALSE))

For shiny versions 0.10.2 and higher, the following should work:

There has been some discussion of this change elsewhere in this group: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/shiny-discuss/-0u-wTnq_lA/7YMBzOZDNXUJ

Kevin
